dossier.scp_unleashed.075.title: Corrosive Snail
dossier.scp_unleashed.075.caption: SCP-075-3 in a holding tray, foot extended, claws fanned forward.

page.title: Special Containment Procedures:
text: SCP-075 instances are to be held one to a tray in a sealed cell lined with glazed stone. Trays are to be checked at the start of every shift.
**Personnel are not to stand within twelve metres of an open tray.** Instances spit when approached.
Armour worn in the containment wing is to be inspected after every shift and replaced at the first sign of pitting.
No shell material of any kind is to be brought into the wing.

page.title: Description:
text: SCP-075 is a snail-like organism a little under a metre long. Its large, pale spiral shell is ridged with fine tan growth lines. In place of a head it has a single brown, deeply wrinkled foot that spreads forward into seven long, jointed digits, each tipped with a dark hooked claw.
SCP-075 moves by reaching forward with every digit at once and dragging the shell after them. It is slow, but it rarely needs to be fast.
When a person comes within roughly twelve metres, SCP-075 stops, turns to face them, rears back and spits a glob of brown matter in a high arc.

The matter is strongly corrosive. Struck personnel report a burning that lasts several seconds, and worn armour pits and weakens quickly. Repeated strikes make it worse. Up close, SCP-075 rakes with its claws.
Instances are active by day and by night alike.

page.title: Addendum 075-1: Appearance
page.text: SCP-075 has no recovery site. Its only recorded group surfaced on the night after a reader finished this file, in open ground nearby. No further groups have surfaced since.

page.title: Addendum 075-2: Observations
text: Shell material left in a holding tray overnight is gone by morning. Nothing else in the tray is disturbed.
Incident 075-04: a field agent struck across the shoulder recovered without lasting harm. %rHis report does not say how.%r

effect.scp_unleashed.scp075_corrosion.de: Something is eating through your armour, and through you.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp075_snail_spaw: SCP-075, the Corrosive Snail: a pale spiral shell carried on a brown, many-clawed foot. It has %s health, and its shell turns aside a great deal.
It hunts players and people. Once its quarry is within about %s blocks it stops, turns to face them, rears back and spits a corrosive glob in an arc.
The corrosion eats into worn armour and wounds whoever it touches for several seconds, and it worsens with every strike. Up close, it rakes with its claws.
It is active by day and by night. It does not occur naturally; its archive file has more on where it comes from.
commands.scp_unleashed.scp075.spawn.fail: There is no room for SCP-075 there
archive.scp_unleashed.notes.scp075.0: No recovery site is on record.
archive.scp_unleashed.notes.scp075.1: They first surface at night, in open ground.
archive.scp_unleashed.notes.scp075.2: Keep your distance. Keep your armour in repair.
